claim: Move max drawdown toward -15/-17 while keeping the strategy above SPY.
causal_mechanism: The three audited champions are all already near -19.2 to -19.8 DD. That makes DD compression a sensible controlled experiment, but only if CAGR stays above SPY.
expected_effect: Move max drawdown toward -15/-17 while keeping the strategy above SPY.
falsification_rule: Reject if DD breaks -20, CAGR <= SPY, or the tighter risk band meaningfully weakens parent DD20 metrics without a compensating DD reduction.

empirical_basis.reason: Champion cluster already sits near the DD cap; this family tests whether that band can be compressed without losing SPY-beating CAGR.

metadata.expected_effect: Target max drawdown -15% with gross exposure capped near 35%.
metadata.why_this_should_help: All current champions are clustered just under the -20% cap; compressed DD is the natural next safety experiment if CAGR survives.
metadata.success_rule: max_drawdown_pct no worse than -20; CAGR must exceed SPY; and one parent DD20 metric must improve materially.
metadata.rejection_rule: Reject if DD < -20, CAGR <= SPY, or no parent metric improves materially.

risk_of_overfit: Controlled: evidence-driven and limited to 12 variants.
novelty_reason: Derived directly from the latest DD20 champion audit and bad-period evidence.
why_not_duplicate: Each variant changes one controlled lever within dd_compression rather than making random parameter noise.
